cta.label: Visit the ForeverHumans Shop →
cta.text: Sizes, colors, and checkout live at the shop — printed when you order, shipped to your door. Thanks for keeping a one-human shop in business.
cta.title: All thirty-one. One store. $17.69 each, one original at $25.

lede: Thirty-one tees. Seventeen sixty-nine each — one original still $25. Real designs, drawn from real lines a real human actually says — no focus groups, no fake countdown timers. Every idea starts in one human's head; the shop runs on Fourthwall — you order, they print it and ship it. Here's the whole lineup:
